title: Gooood app
body: I love this app, it’s been four days and I’m remembering to make my bed and use stuff that I would usually forget to do. But I think the reminders for task or goals or whatever could be a little bit more encouraging instead of just notification from Finch: “ make bed”

title: So far pretty good
body: I’ve been using the app for 5 days and to be honest I find it great. It’s got such a touch of gentleness and it’s pretty inclusive as well. Struggling or not, you get supportive notifications too. It’s also one of the few apps that don’t spam ads on you. Dear creators, please keep it that way!
